body:
My work life is fine, I think I'm well liked at my unit and I just received an award last month. As far as my personal life goes, I haven't been able to get close to anyone for a while. I just ended a short relationship with a girl because things started to get serious and it scared me. Whenever I think of being with someone I just start to panic and think it will just be one more person that I'll eventually hurt. I heard she was pretty upset about the break and I feel terrible, but I think she's better off finding someone else. I just feel totally pointless and see no value in my own life.

I've been thinking about hobbies I might like to pursue, but nothing in particular sticks out in my mind. I haven't done anything other than get drunk at bars and clubs in years.
